quests.title: The Grave Message
quests.description: Bring the Arcane University's warning to the king.

objectives.text: Find the king's hall at the end of the corridor
Deliver the University's message to the king

quests.title: Trouble at the Dig
quests.description: The diggers have breached a goblin encampment. The king wants it cleared.

objectives.text: Speak with the king in his hall
Leave the castle through the entrance doors
Collect your sword near the Quartermaster's shop
Help the guards clear the goblins from the dig site
